verdict.rationale: Pipecat provides building blocks — AudioBufferProcessor for capturing audio recordings and turn-event based transcript collection — that a platform engineer could wire into their own storage/retrieval system, but there's no documented built-in centralized recordings/transcripts store or query API for retrieving them programmatically across all calls. Missing for 10: a first-party recordings/transcripts storage service or retrieval API, evidence of per-call metadata/indexing, and any hands-on confirmation of retrieving historical call data at scale.
